title: axial.native spec
description: What an axial.native request asks for: an engine's own figures of the beam along the axis of a system whose object is at infinity, from rays launched parallel to the axis at fractions of the engine's own pupil radius at the first line asked, the same heights at every line. spherical: one line; the near-axis zone, the candidates of the marginal zone in the order they are tried, and the zones of the profile; each zone is a ray and its mirror image. colour: the lines, the first of them the reference of the relative focus, and the candidates of the marginal ray, one ray each. Code checks that the lines of a request are distinct.

oneOf.description: Spherical aberration at one line, as LensVisualizer's spherical-aberration section presents it.

lines.description: The index of the one line of the case, in conditions.lines.

nearAxis.description: The fraction of the pupil of the near-axis zone, the reference of the figures.

marginal.description: The candidates of the marginal zone, in the order they are tried: the first whose two rays both cross the axis is taken.

profile.description: The zones of the profile, whose pairs' least-squares focus is the best focus; the near-axis zone is one of them for the profile to have a reference.

oneOf.description: Axial colour at several lines, as LensVisualizer's axial-colour section presents it.

lines.description: Indices of lines of the case, in conditions.lines, each once; the first is the reference of the relative focus.

marginal.description: The candidates of the marginal ray, in the order they are tried: the first whose ray crosses the axis at two of the lines (at the one line of a request of one) is taken.
